taskDescription: Locate the anchor function for the byte_payload field in the console.log object whose action is packet.transform after entering the source bytes, setting the chunk size, selecting the delta encoding mode and bulk profile, enabling the header option, clicking Stage, and clicking Emit on the page. The anchor function is the first target-specific byte-array payload constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after two-stage routing, click-time runtime collection, packet configuration collection and input preparation, its function body itself constructs the target observable byte-array payload value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing to the console. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, byte-payload wrappers, or the final sink.
